description: Paste JSON to pretty-print it with 2 or 4 space indentation, minify it, or validate it with precise error messages.

faqs.a: The tool shows the exact JSON.parse error, including the character position where parsing failed, so you can find the problem quickly.
faqs.q: What happens if my JSON is invalid?

faqs.a: Minify removes all unnecessary whitespace, producing the most compact valid JSON. Great for shrinking payloads.
faqs.q: Does Minify remove anything besides whitespace?

faqs.a: Yes. Everything runs locally in your browser — your JSON is never sent to any server.
faqs.q: Is my JSON sent to a server?

howto: Paste your JSON into the input box, or click Sample to load an example.
Choose Format (2-space), Format (4-space), Minify, or Validate.
Read the result, or the exact parse error if the JSON is invalid.
Copy the result or download it as a .json file.
title: JSON Formatter
